objective: minimize sum_f omega_f ||Y_f - Xh_f W||^2 over legal lattice projections, Y_f = X_f W_orig^T, Xh = parent dynamic activation decode
rows: all calibration rows of every fold (no parity fit/select split): basis construction, coefficient solve, fold weights, and acceptance all use the same full weighted set
subspace_per_block: G = sum_omega Xh_B^T Xh_B + lam*I; H = sum_omega Xh_B^T R; Cholesky(L): G = L L^T; Hw = L^-1 H; rank-8 truncated SVD; dW = L^-T U_r U_r^T Hw
ridge: inherit parent block ridge (narrow 0.2 / wide 0.3 by width), no sweep
acceptance: strict all-calibration-row target L improvement after legal grid projection; ties retain parent block
residual_maintenance: incremental: R = Y - Xh W^T once, then per accepted block R <- R - Xh_B @ (Wq - Wb0); no per-block full matrix products or full-weight clones
writeback: fixed parent scale/lv2/lv3; only accepted blocks get new sign/mant; unaccepted blocks keep parent bit-fields
teacher: X W_orig^T (non-quantized original NVFP4 weight decode)
fit_select: none (removed 2026-09-08 per user correction directive; verified absent)
online_cost: no per-call loop growth, no extra online matrices; all fitting inside calibration
official_status: PENDING_OFFICIAL (registered for official exploration per workpackage 21071-evidence-driven-research §4)
